COURSE 1 · THE STORY

Welcome kaapiಸ್ವಾಗತ

StoryThree promisesMenuMission

1.1 The story

For the first time in Abbigere — authentic South Indian food, cooked the traditional way in a kitchen you can trust. Your new neighbourhood destination for divine food.

Live vada machine

Fresh, hot vadas made in front of you, all day.

Traditional ingredients

Recipes and ingredients the way homes in Karnataka cook them.

Hygiene-focused preparation

Clean kitchen, steel counters, careful hands.

These three promises are from the Grand Opening poster. Keep them in every launch, banner and menu.

1.2 On the menu

The tiffin classics

What the posters lead with. Confirm the full menu, meal timings and specialities with the Manna team.

Masala dosa

Crisp, golden, with potato palya

Medu vada

Hot from the live vada machine

Idli

Soft, steamed, with chutneys

Sambar & chutney

Steel bowls, refilled with a smile

Filter kaapi

Brass tumbler and dabara

1.3 Mission

To serve Abbigere honest, authentic South Indian food — traditional taste, modern hygiene, every single plate.

Vision

To be the neighbourhood’s favourite place for breakfast, a quick meal and filter kaapi with family.

DRAFT Mission and vision are written from the posters. Confirm with the Hotel Manna owners.

The emblemಲಾಂಛನ

AnatomyVersionsKannada nameSpaceMisuse

2.1 Anatomy

She serves with devotion

The emblem is a woman in a red-and-gold saree offering a steaming cup with both hands — hospitality as an offering. That’s the meaning of “Divine Food”.

123456
  1. 1

    Saffron sun

    The circle in Manna Saffron — warmth, morning, the stove.

  2. 2

    Jasmine and jhumka

    Mallige in her hair, gold jhumkas — Karnataka tradition.

  3. 3

    The offering

    A brass cup of steaming food or kaapi, held in both hands.

  4. 4

    Red and gold saree

    The colours we borrow for offers and festive posts.

  5. 5

    HOTEL MANNA

    Flared, classical capitals in charcoal.

  6. 6

    DIVINE FOOD

    Wide-spaced, lighter — the promise under the name.

Rebuilt from the poster logo (upscaled 4×). For signage and print, ask the designer for the original vector or high-resolution file.

2.2 Versions

Four ways to sign

Stacked — primary

Posters, menus, banners, packaging.

HOTEL MANNADIVINE FOOD

Horizontal NEW

Website header, bills, letterhead, delivery bags.

HOTEL MANNADIVINE FOOD

Reversed on maroon

The signboard version — white name, turmeric line.

Emblem

Profile picture, stickers, parcel seals, cups.

ಹೋಟೆಲ್ ಮನ್ನಾದೈವಿಕ ಆಹಾರ

The Kannada name, as on the signboard. Use it with the English name on boards, menus and local posts.

Hotel MannaDIVINE FOOD

Kannada and English always the same size and weight — neither is the “translation”.

2.3 Space and size

Give her room

xxxx

Clear space on every side equals x, the height of the “H” in HOTEL. The full logo works only on Cream, Rice white or white. On maroon, green or photos, use the emblem with the name set beside it.

Minimum sizes: stacked logo 140 px / 35 mm wide; emblem 40 px / 10 mm.

2.4 Misuse

Not on our menu

COURSE 3 · COLOUR

Spice boxಬಣ್ಣ

Seven spicesProportionContrast

3.1 The spice box

Colours from the kitchen

Like a masala dabba: each colour has its own bowl and its own job. Saffron and maroon come from the emblem and signboard; leaf green, turmeric and brass from the plate. Tap a bowl to copy its code.

3.2 Proportion

Mostly rice, a pinch of chilli

55% Coconut cream
18% Leaf
14% Maroon
8%

Cream lets the food glow. Leaf green and temple maroon frame it. Saffron and turmeric are the seasoning — the offer, the button, one word.

COURSE 5 · GRAPHICS

Leaf edgeKolamPromise ruleIconsPlateOffer badge

5.1 Graphic elements

Leaf, kolam and brass

Six building blocks from a South Indian kitchen. Use them the same way every time.

The leaf edge

A scalloped banana-leaf border for the top or bottom of posters, menus and this book.

Kolam dots

A faint dot grid and one rangoli flower, for backgrounds and festive posts.

Traditional Taste • Modern Hygiene

The promise rule

The tagline between two saffron lines — straight from the first poster.

Promise icons

Saffron, leaf and turmeric circles with white line icons, on a white card.

The steel plate

Food photos in a round steel-plate frame — the shape of our emblem.

OPENING OFFER

Breakfast free

10:30 AM – 12:00 PM

Offer badge

Maroon with a turmeric border — for offers only, never for everyday posts.

COURSE 6 · PHOTOGRAPHY

On the plateತಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ

Three rulesWhat to avoid

6.1 Photography

Hot, fresh, on the leaf

The launch poster sets the look: food on banana leaf, warm wood, steel bowls, a brass tumbler, soft daylight.

01

Leaf, steel and wood

Every dish on a banana leaf or steel plate, on a wooden table. Brass tumbler and curry leaves as the only props.

  • Soft daylight from one side
  • Steam is welcome — shoot it hot
02

The live vada machine

Our unique selling point. Film the batter dropping and the vadas turning gold, close and in slow motion.

  • Clean steel counters in frame
  • Gloves, caps and aprons on every hand
03

A kitchen you can trust

Show the clean kitchen and the counter as often as the food — “modern hygiene” needs proof.

  • Bright, even light
  • Staff in uniform, smiling
AVOIDPlastic plates or paper cups in photos
AVOIDCold, dark or yellow-lit food
AVOIDStock food that isn’t ours, once real photos exist
AVOIDMessy counters or bare hands near food

The launch posters use generated food and storefront images. Replace them with real photos of Manna’s dishes and store in the first weeks after opening.

COURSE 7 · WRITING

The voiceಮಾತು

PersonalityWrite thisWords

7.1 Personality

The amma who runs a tidy kitchen

Warm, homely and proud — but precise about cleanliness. Speaks English and Kannada like the neighbourhood does.

Homely

Food like at home: “ಮನೆಯ ರುಚಿ”, made fresh, served warm.

Devoted

“Divine food” is a promise of care, not a religious claim.

Clean

Say how we keep it hygienic. Show, don’t just claim.

Local

Abbigere first. Name landmarks people know.

Write this

Hot vadas, straight from the live vada machine. Come early!

Traditional taste, modern hygiene — your new tiffin spot in Abbigere.

ಬಿಸಿ ಬಿಸಿ ಮಸಾಲೆ ದೋಸೆ, ಮನೆಯ ರುಚಿಯಲ್ಲಿ.

Not this

BEST HOTEL IN BANGALORE!!! 🔥🔥🔥

Cheap food, come fast, limited stock.

All items available, call for details.

Hotel MannaAlways this. Not “Manna Hotel” or “Hotel Mana”.
Divine FoodUnder the name. Kannada: ದೈವಿಕ ಆಹಾರ.
Tiffin, meals, kaapiUse local words, not “snacks” or “coffee beverages”.
One or two emoji🍃 ☕ at most. No fire emojis.
